info.description:
**Snapp Box B2B HTTP API for partners integrating order, pricing, wallet, and customer flows.** [B2B API Integration Guide](/docs/integration-guide)

**Authentication:** Call `POST /v1/oauth2/token` to obtain an access token with OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Send the access token on protected routes in the Authorization header.

**Reference types:** See **Definitions** for values used on this API — e.g. `OrderStatusType`, `TerminalStatusType`, `WebhookEventType`, `WebhookCallbackBody`, `ErrorKeyType`.
